gloss: to keep in mind, to try to

definitions.gloss: to keep in mind, to bear in mind, to try to do, to make an effort to
definitions.explanation: To consciously try to do something or pay attention to something as a habit or practice.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}に{心|こころ}がける。
examples.english: To be mindful of one's health.

examples.japanese: {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きを{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I try to go to bed early and wake up early.

examples.japanese: {日頃|ひごろ}から{礼儀|れいぎ}{正|ただ}しくあることを{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I make an effort to be polite on a daily basis.

notes:
{心|こころ}がける means to consciously try to do something or keep something in mind.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{心|こころ}がける / 〜ことを{心|こころ}がける

ASPECT (ている):
- {心|こころ}がけている: making an ongoing effort, trying habitually

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{心|こころ}がける: to be mindful of ~
- 〜ように{心|こころ}がける: to try to ~
- 〜ことを{心|こころ}がける: to make an effort to ~

EXAMPLES:
- {健康|けんこう}を{心|こころ}がける (to be mindful of health)
- {バランス}の{良|よ}い{食事|しょくじ}を{心|こころ}がける (to try to eat a balanced diet)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {気|き}をつける: to be careful, to pay attention
- {努|つと}める: to strive, to make an effort
